moments.title: Strictly Live Shows Begin
moments.blurb: The glitz and glamour of Strictly Come Dancing returns with its first live show of the series this Saturday, following last night's launch.

angles.name: Main Show Hook
angles.copy: Strictly's back! The pairings are done, the sequins are sparkling, and the first live shows kick off this Saturday. Who are you backing for the Glitterball? #Strictly

angles.name: New Hosts Angle
angles.copy: New era, new dance floor drama! Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe are ready to host the first live Strictly Come Dancing show this Saturday. Get ready!

moments.title: Great British Bake Off Starts
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off returns for its 17th series this Tuesday on Channel 4, with new judge Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood.

angles.name: Bake Off Excitement
angles.copy: Get ready to pre-heat your ovens! The Great British Bake Off is back on Tuesday, with a fresh batch of bakers and new judge Nigella Lawson. Who's excited for Cake Week?

angles.name: New Judge Focus
angles.copy: Nigella in the tent! The iconic Nigella Lawson joins Paul Hollywood as a new judge on The Great British Bake Off, starting this Tuesday. What bakes are you hoping to see?

moments.title: Autumn Equinox
moments.blurb: Astronomical autumn officially begins on Wednesday, September 23rd at 01:05 BST, marking the Autumn Equinox.

angles.name: Autumn Begins
angles.copy: Say hello to astronomical autumn! The Autumn Equinox arrives this Wednesday at 01:05 BST. Time for cosy nights, crunchy leaves, and pumpkin spice everything. 🍂

angles.name: Seasonal Change
angles.copy: The days officially get shorter than the nights from Wednesday as the Autumn Equinox marks the start of astronomical autumn. What's your favourite thing about this season?

moments.title: Gallagher Premiership Rugby Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The 2026-27 Gallagher Premiership Rugby season begins this Friday, September 25th, with a new season of top-flight action.

angles.name: Season Start
angles.copy: Rugby's back! The Gallagher Premiership season kicks off this Friday. Who are you tipping for the title this year?

angles.name: Exeter Chiefs Hook
angles.copy: Our Exeter Chiefs kick off their Premiership campaign this Saturday as they face Gloucester! Get ready to support the boys at Sandy Park!

moments.title: Nuno Bettencourt's 60th Birthday

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Happy 60th to the incredible Nuno Bettencourt of Extreme! Still shredding like it's the 80s. What's your favourite Extreme track?

angles.name: Grunge Icon
angles.copy: Happy 58th birthday to Ben Shepherd, the legendary bassist of Soundgarden! What's your favourite riff he laid down?

angles.name: Rock Icon

angles.name: The Boss

angles.name: Fresh Prince

moments.title: Anastacia at OVO Arena Wembley

moments.title: Loreen's UK Tour Dates

angles.name: Eurovision Star Live
angles.copy: Loreen's 'Wildfire Tour' hits the UK this week! Catch the Eurovision champ in Glasgow (Thurs), Manchester (Fri), and London (Sat). Which city are you seeing her in?

angles.name: London Gig Alert
angles.copy: Eurovision queen Loreen is bringing her 'Wildfire Tour' to O2 Academy Brixton this Saturday! Don't miss out on seeing her live.

moments.title: Black Parade - 00's Emo Anthems in Exeter

angles.name: Emo Night Exeter
angles.copy: Calling all pop-punk and emo fans! Get ready for 'Black Parade - 00's Emo Anthems' at The Cavern this Friday. Dig out your skinny jeans! 🤘

angles.name: Timeless Voice
angles.copy: A true legend turns 91 this Wednesday! Happy birthday to the iconic Johnny Mathis, whose voice has serenaded generations. What's your favourite of his classics?
